sentences.text: For a UCB, the current RBI rule says that any penalty for non-repayment within the due date shall be levied only as penal charges and not as penal interest, and the UCB rules also say penal interest is not permitted.
The older 2023 RBI circular on penal charges and penal interest is no longer in force on the as-of date, so it does not govern the current compliance check.

I cannot determine whether section 8.2 of the Retail Loan Policy complies, because the section text was not provided and no evidence shows whether it uses penal interest or only penal charges within the current RBI conditions.
